name: Viltrox
source: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0104/0380/7298/files/AF_35-1.2_LAB_FE_Manual.pdf (official VILTROX AF 35mm F1.2 LAB FE user manual, CorelDRAW 2020 vector PDF, page 1 cover wordmark; linked from https://viltrox.com/pages/af-35-1-2-lab-fe)
license: Public domain as a simple text logo below the threshold of originality (Wikimedia Commons tags the same VILTROX wordmark {{PD-textlogo}} at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Viltrox_logo_black.png; this is a US-centric copyright assessment, not a licence granted by Viltrox). Vector extracted from the official manual PDF. Trademark rights still apply.
notes: No Simple Icons entry and no SVG on Wikimedia Commons (only PNGs: File:Viltrox_logo_black.png, File:Viltrox-logo-s-U-E--2a67fab9-1920w.png); viltrox.com serves only a PNG header logo and has no press kit. Vector taken instead from Viltrox's own manual PDF (not traced): the 7 black filled shapes of the cover wordmark were read with PyMuPDF get_drawings (page coordinates, all PDF matrices already applied), translated to origin and rounded to 0.001. Geometry is identical in the AF 85mm F1.4 FE manual (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0104/0380/7298/files/AF_85-1.4_FE_User_manual.pdf) and matches the current viltrox.com header logo. One path per letter V-I-L-T-R-O-X; only the O has a counter (second subpath), set to evenodd; the R is open (no counter). Italic all-caps horizontal wordmark, no symbol, no (R) mark.
